lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kestrel drifts toward the Bloom, its seam burning crimson.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: I'm sorry. Captain, I'm so sorry.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: It's not your fault, Moss. Keep cutting. Cut anything.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind them, Halcyon turns: every engine lit, nose pointed at Kestrel.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Through the static, one line gets through.
